KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.3: So I have been offloading gypsum stock, selling high now, ready to buy it back when their value bottoms out.
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.2: They're surprisingly good at it. The advantages of descending from skilled hunters I suppose.
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.1: Oh praise great Fuzan! His wings will block out the Scorch, his talons will hold back the KotHaar.
KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.1: I have been speculating on the markets after Fuzan Mark Day.
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.3: Oh? You haven't seen any kids around? Wow, they're doing really well then!
KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.2: With Fuzan's protection, we won't have to worry about KotHaar. We would be able to mine gypsum more freely.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.2: I was thinking maybe some cactus steaks, carved in the shape of the Mark. Or maybe that's too much?
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.1: Three - two - one. Coming, ready or not! Oh... sorry, hello? I'm playing hide and seek with the kids.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.1: I am so busy baking for Fuzan Mark Day! I have goat pies prepared, and little biscuits in the shape of dragons.
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.2: Gone are the days of merely surviving. With his eyes upon us, we will thrive!
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.3: The weak Manafem and the coward Alcarrid will turn to us with envy. What a future faces us all!
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.1: We've always been a slow, considered people. We don't need to make hasty decisions.
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.2: So why is Mark Day so soon? Couldn't we have waited a month or two? Why is Fuzan so eager to hold the Mark Day now?
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.3: I have no time to make costumes for the party. No time at all!
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.1: My poor son. Have you seen him? He left for Alcarrid weeks ago. We couldn't follow him: we are too old for such a journey.
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.2: Ach, I hope he doesn't come back for us. His life wends in front of him like a river. Son, please don't fight the currents.
